newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bordeaux air cargo traffic stable Jan-Aug 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bordeaux air cargo traffic stable Jan-Aug 1996.

text.p: Bordeaux's Merignac airport said it handled 5,076 tonnes of air cargo traffic in the first eight months of 1996, compared to 5,086 tonnes, in the same period last year.
Bordeaux features on DHL's Worldwide Express weekday Brussels western France air cargo service.
The service operates Brussels-Nantes-Bordeaux and uses a 6.5 tonnes-capacity Convair aircraft.
Earlier this month, United Parcel Service of America Inc (UPS), launched a weekday feeder service between Lyon-Satolas airport and Bordeaux using a two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
Postal traffic handled until August at Bordeaux totalled 8,477 tonnes, an increase of 22 percent on 1995 levels.
French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Bordeaux on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft.
